default_lifecycle: plan -> sandbox -> evidence -> owner/developer review -> execute within approval boundary -> archive learning
merge_rule: If two sub-bot blueprints repeatedly solve the same job with high capability overlap, merge their responsibilities into one stronger blueprint and preserve the old names as aliases.
spawn_rule: Every canonical bot may request a temporary team from these blueprints when the task is broader than its direct capability set. Temporary teams do not become permanent fleet profiles unless repeated demand and regression evidence justify promotion.
data_rule: Use only user-owned, user-authorized, licensed, public-domain, or otherwise permitted data. Prefer read-only imports, provenance, user controls, encryption, export, deletion, and minimal retention. Never collect data merely because it is technically accessible.
